story: Prahaara begins with three reclaimed South Indian pillar sections sourced from Kodagu—architectural remnants that had already lived one life before reaching NAD. Crafted originally in different native woods including teak, jackfruit wood, and vaimaram, their surviving upper sections retain the proportions, turnings, marks, and irregularities left behind by time.
tagline: Three remnants of architecture, given another lifetime.
name: Prahaara
